summary: Gossamer Bio filed an 8-K on September 9, 2026 disclosing that its board selected a 1-for-80 reverse stock split, following stockholder approval on July 14, 2026 of thirty alternate amendments and a proportionate authorized-share reduction. The split and authorized share reduction take effect September 10, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. ET, with split-adjusted trading on Nasdaq under GOSS and new CUSIP 38341P 201 on September 11. The action is intended to regain compliance with Nasdaq's minimum bid price listing requirement; no board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms were disclosed. Convertible note conversion rates, warrant terms, and equity awards adjust proportionately. Watch for confirmation of regained compliance, potential continued listing deficiency risk, and any dilution or financing overhang.
